about: Dates of the holidays that have no rule the page can work out (the others come from the calendars of the engine, ike/resources/greeting.js). Diwali: the main day (Lakshmi Puja); Holi: Dhulandi (for 2027 drikpanchang says 22 March, India's central list 23 March); Lunar New Year: the day it falls on in China (the engine's own calendar is a day off in some years, 2027 among them, so these years are listed and other years come from the engine); Vesak: the full moon of May as Sri Lanka keeps it (other countries differ), only the years with an official source: from 2028 there is no Vesak greeting until the table is refreshed. Checked on 2026-11-23 against drikpanchang.com, samvat.in, panchang.astrosage.com, travelchinaguide.com, calendardate.com, Sri Lanka's gazette 2438/22, the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and publicholidays.lk. This table must be refreshed every year (a task for AUTOMAT).
